How to join

  • Every ₱200 deposit made between 12:00 PM and 9:00 PM (Philippine time) = 1 race entry.
  • Maximum 5 entries per player per day. Each entry needs 1× turnover of the deposit first — bets on any game count.
  • Your agent adds your User ID to the next race. Races run until 11:59 PM; entries do not carry over to the next day.
  • Prizes go by finishing place. 1st (₱177) and 2nd (₱77) are display only and can never be won by a player.
  • Total bonus paid by this promo is capped at ₱10,000 per day for all players.

Wins are recorded automatically and credited the following day at 1:00 PM after verification. Results are final: the race is decided by the server the moment the agent presses Start, and replaying or reloading the page does not change it. This is an animated promo game only, not a bet.
